name: Build Provenance Attestations
description: Sigstore-based build provenance: what was built, from which commit, by which builder, with which dependencies.
purpose: Create cryptographically verifiable attestations for every build so consumers can independently verify the origin, builder identity, and input state of any artifact.
acceptanceCriteria: Build provenance attestations are generated using Sigstore (in-toto attestation format).
Each attestation records: source commit SHA, builder identity, build platform, build timestamp.
Attestations include the full dependency tree used during the build.
Attestations are signed and published to Rekor transparency log.
Attestations can be verified independently (cosign verify-attestation).
Attestation generation is idempotent and integrated into the CI pipeline.
Failure to generate or publish an attestation fails the build.
